relation_types.BASELINE_PLUS_INTENSIFIER: The baseline remains active; the optional capability intensifies one narrow behaviour.
relation_types.SUBSTITUTE: Choose one capability for the same job in the same phase.
relation_types.COMPLEMENTARY: Capabilities solve distinct parts and may pair.
relation_types.SEQUENTIAL: Capabilities overlap broadly but are strongest in different phases.
relation_types.REFERENCE_ONLY: Use for inspiration or evidence, not as an active execution skill.
relation_types.META_OBSERVER: Observes and recommends changes but does not own execution.

groups.rule: Karpathy Guidelines remain the baseline for thinking, surgical changes and verifiable goals. Ponytail may intensify implementation minimalism when overengineering risk is high.
The constitution is supreme. Use UI/UX Pro Max for research/specification, one art director for brainstorming, frontend-design for implementation, Impeccable for audit/polish and Emil for motion.
Native writing-quality owns content clarity and business usefulness. Stop Slop is a final anti-AI-pattern lint pass.
Task Observer may log repeated gaps. Skill governance owns evaluation, promotion, overlap and retirement. Task Observer must not rewrite skills automatically.
Escapement owns runtime, state and evidence. Use component-level adapters from external methodologies at their strongest phases; do not install competing complete lifecycle hooks together.
File state is default. Claude Mem, AppFlowy or HelixDB may become the primary external memory substrate only after a demonstrated need. Graphify may complement file state for code relationships.
Choose by evidence type: authoritative public facts, technical documentation, grounded research, recent discourse or platform-specific reach. Maximum two supporting channels per research question.
Use the project's existing browser test framework first. Select one primary driver per run; do not duplicate browser automation stacks.
Choose one primary review workflow. Add a second independent reviewer only for material/high-risk changes with a stated reason.
Use the existing project component system first. External component sources require stack, licence, accessibility and visual-consistency review.
